versions.content: Hard error occurs during the execution of a transformer chain If a hard error occurs during the execution of a transformer chain which is executed • on the server side of a client/server communication and re-transforms the data which trigger a server RunnableEntity or • on the trigger sink side of an inter-ECU external trigger communication, this server RunnableEntity or trigger sink RunnableEntity cannot be started be- cause the re-transformed data are not available.
